description: This module can be used to manage Kibana plugins.

parameters.name: allow_root
parameters.description: Whether to allow kibana and kibana-plugin to be run as root. Passes the --allow-root flag to these commands. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Delete and re-install the plugin. It can be useful for plugins update. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the plugin to install.

parameters.name: plugin_bin
parameters.description: Location of the Kibana binary. Default: "/opt/kibana/bin/kibana"

parameters.name: plugin_dir
parameters.description: Your configured plugin directory specified in Kibana. Default: "/opt/kibana/installedPlugins/"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Desired state of a plugin. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Timeout setting: 30s, 1m, 1h and so on. Default: "1m"

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Set exact URL to download the plugin from. For local file, prefix its absolute path with file://.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Version of the plugin to be installed. If the plugin is installed with in a previous version, it is not updated unless force=true.

examples:
- name: Install Elasticsearch head plugin
  community.general.kibana_plugin:
    state: present
    name: elasticsearch/marvel

- name: Install specific version of a plugin
  community.general.kibana_plugin:
    state: present
    name: elasticsearch/marvel
    version: '2.3.3'

- name: Uninstall Elasticsearch head plugin
  community.general.kibana_plugin:
    state: absent
    name: elasticsearch/marvel

return_values.name: cmd
return_values.description: The launched command during plugin management (install / remove). Returned: success

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: The plugin name to install or remove. Returned: success

return_values.name: state
return_values.description: The state for the managed plugin. Returned: success

return_values.name: timeout
return_values.description: The timeout for plugin download. Returned: success

return_values.name: url
return_values.description: The URL from where the plugin is installed from. Returned: success
